description: Copies the registration and thank-you pages of an existing webinar onto another one, which is how a host reuses a page design after a migration. Side effect: the target campaign's own pages are REPLACED by the copied ones and the copy cannot be undone; the source campaign is not touched. Needs `session_id`, `source_id`, `target_id` from wi_list_webinars and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Say which two webinars are involved and that the target's current pages are overwritten before you write. Read what stands on the target first with wi_get_webinar_page_blocks.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that the target's pages may be replaced.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

source_id.description: The webinar whose pages are copied, from wi_list_webinars.

target_id.description: The webinar whose pages are replaced, from wi_list_webinars.

name: wi_copy_webinar_pages
title: Copy the pages of one webinar onto another
